construction.contact_offset_correction: Previous report used 0.502 mm = via radius 0.302 + 0.20. This review uses released 0.25 mm contact clearance: 0.302 + 0.25 = 0.552 mm in baseline and every counterfactual.

decision_support.geometry_result: Every single-track omission and the all-four omission leave both targets' region areas, bounds, component counts and representative outcomes identical to the corrected-contact baseline.
decision_support.topology_result: 2439bd57, 56011162 and 76a37864 are graph-redundant individually but provide no return-space benefit. Removing 8b67bfa8 isolates R14.1 from +3V3. Removing all four also leaves track c9710cc0-50df-5774-9f36-cc826d52b949 as floating copper.
decision_support.root_decision: The allowlisted local F.Cu +3V3 tracks are not preventing an ordinary IMU return connection. A minimal supply-layer transfer based only on removing these tracks is unsupported; treat the present result as an immutable-layout limitation requiring a different explicitly engineered approach.
interpretation: Graph redundancy alone does not approve removal; decoupling, chip-select tie, current path and return interaction remain dependencies.
Empty conservative domains are not global impossibility.
